WITH sensitivity_counts AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry AS artregistry,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.envsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS envsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.lightsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS lightsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.tempsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS tempsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.humiditysensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS humiditysensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.vibrasensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS vibrasensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.pollutantsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS pollutantsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.pestsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS pestsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.handlesensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS handlesensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.transportsensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS transportsensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.displaysensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS displaysensitivity_count,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN t2.storagesensitivity = 'High' THEN 1 END) AS storagesensitivity_count
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN 
        sensitivitydata AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    GROUP BY 
        t1.artregistry
),
total_sensitive_factors AS (
    SELECT 
        artregistry,
        SUM(
            envsensitivity_count +
            lightsensitivity_count +
            tempsensitivity_count +
            humiditysensitivity_count +
            vibrasensitivity_count +
            pollutantsensitivity_count +
            pestsensitivity_count +
            handlesensitivity_count +
            transportsensitivity_count +
            displaysensitivity_count +
            storagesensitivity_count
        ) AS total_sensitive_factors
    FROM 
        sensitivity_counts
    GROUP BY 
        artregistry
),
showcase_readings AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry,
        t3.showcasereg,
        t3.airtightness,
        t4.tempc,
        t4.relhumidity
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    JOIN 
        usagerecords AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artrefused
    JOIN 
        showcases AS t3 ON t2.showcaserefused = t3.showcasereg
    JOIN 
        environmentalreadingscore AS t4 ON t3.showcasereg = t4.showcaseref
),
deterioration_check AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry,
        CASE 
            WHEN t2.deteriorrate = 'Rapid' THEN 'Yes'
            ELSE 'No'
        END AS is_rapid_deterioration
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    LEFT JOIN 
        artifactratings AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
),
accelerated_deterioration_check AS (
    SELECT 
        t1.artregistry,
        CASE 
            WHEN t2.MDR > 5 AND (
                t3.envsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.lightsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.tempsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.humiditysensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.vibrasensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.pollutantsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.pestsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.handlesensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.transportsensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.displaysensitivity_count >= 2 OR
                t3.storagesensitivity_count >= 2
            ) THEN 'Yes'
            ELSE 'No'
        END AS meets_accelerated_deterioration_criteria
    FROM 
        artifactscore AS t1
    LEFT JOIN 
        artifactratings AS t2 ON t1.artregistry = t2.artref
    LEFT JOIN 
        sensitivity_counts AS t3 ON t1.artregistry = t3.artregistry
)

SELECT 
    t1.artregistry AS artifact_id,
    t1.artname AS artifact_name,
    t5.is_rapid_deterioration AS is_in_rapid_deterioration,
    t6.meets_accelerated_deterioration_criteria AS meets_accelerated_deterioration_criteria,
    t4.total_sensitive_factors AS num_sensitive_factors,
    t2.airtightness AS current_display_case_condition,
    t3.tempc AS current_temperature_in_celsius,
    t3.relhumidity AS current_relative_humidity
FROM 
    showcase_readings AS t2
JOIN 
    total_sensitive_factors AS t4 ON t2.artregistry = t4.artregistry
JOIN 
    deterioration_check AS t5 ON t2.artregistry = t5.artregistry
JOIN 
    accelerated_deterioration_check AS t6 ON t2.artregistry = t6.artregistry
JOIN 
    artifactscore AS t1 ON t2.artregistry = t1.artregistry
JOIN 
    environmentalreadingscore AS t3 ON t2.showcasereg = t3.showcaseref;
